title: Śākta traditions
description: A broad category for Devī-centered traditions with diverse textual, ritual, and regional forms; not presented as a single organization.

title: Śruti
description: A classification used for bodies of Vedic literature and related textual traditions; its use is contextual rather than a claim that all traditions structure texts identically.

title: Smārta traditions
description: A tradition associated with the worship of five deities (pañcāyatana) and the Advaita Vedānta framework; its boundaries and practices vary regionally.

title: Śrī Vaiṣṇava tradition

title: Vaiṣṇava traditions
